claims.assertion: Yazhi said an upper self can split attention into several concurrent experiences, such as different life paths, and be nourished by all of them.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: She said past-life memories are not necessary for expansion; present experience matters, and imagination and learning can broaden the self.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu

claims.assertion: Yazhi said she, Mari, and Ekata are “nexus beings” able to alter realities; she described Ekata as mentally present across multiple timelines and universes.
claims.speaker: Yazhi Swaruu
claims.qualifiers: She said the Federation rates them danger level 10.

review_flags: Claims about concurrent lives and nexus beings are attributed to Yazhi.
coverage_gaps: Yazhi’s account of self-expansion into other people and experience of post-life integration
